traits.name: Flyby
traits.text: The snake doesn’t provoke an Opportunity At- tack when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The elephant makes two Gore attacks.

actions.name: Gore
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the elephant moved 20+ feet straight to- ward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition. Bonus Actions

actions.name: Trample
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that has the Prone condition. Failure: 17 (2d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage. Elk
